name: counter
description: Counter — multi-restaurant POS: floor, kitchen ticket rail and admin, with live order updates

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && cd apps/web && npx tsc --noEmit
